motion.purpose: Full neutral morph cycle, approximately 1.75 seconds.

motion.name: return-delay
motion.purpose: Elapsed from activation before return begins.

motion.name: reduced-morph
motion.purpose: Response and return with reduced motion; idle remains still.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Button background, border, and press movement.

motion.name: widget-return-delay
motion.purpose: Embedded widget delay from response activation before return begins; standalone stays at 1.45s.

shadows.name: widget-panel
shadows.purpose: Separate the question panel from the host lesson; the artifact has no background or halo.

components.name: Widget panel
components.description: Compact input and arrow send row. Two parallel Jev noul judgments require eligibility ≥0.65; answer probability ≥0.60 shows Yes, ≤0.40 shows No, otherwise neutral unknown. Shared timeout: 25 seconds.

components.name: Widget question or statement
components.description: Accessible, borderless input for a question or statement, maximum 400 characters.
components.html: <input class="ds-widget-input" aria-label="A question or statement about this lesson" maxlength="400" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Ask or check a statement…">

components.name: Widget arrow send
components.description: 44px arrow submit control; disabled while a judgment is pending.

narrative.overview:
The approved TRON reference owns the visual world. A luminous, faceted artifact occupies generous dark space; compact controls and quiet text support it. Preserve this existing direction when extending the player.

The embedded lesson widget is an intentional second surface: the same geometric artifact floats without a background or halo, while its question panel adopts the host’s paper, violet, typography, and rounded controls. Full-page tokens remain authoritative for the standalone player; widget-prefixed tokens apply only to the embedded panel.
keyCharacteristics: Clean planar geometry with reflective materials.
Equal Yes and No controls with restrained color.
Host-matched paper and violet for the embedded question panel.
dos: Do keep the live artifact visually dominant.
Do preserve clean planar facets and equal response controls.
Do retain keyboard, focus, status, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep the embedded artifact transparent and its panel aligned with the host.
donts: Don't introduce a new brand or decorative dashboard furniture.
Don't restore video playback or a scrubber as the primary interaction.
Don't apply the widget panel palette, radius, or typography to the standalone player.
